name: Wuhan East Lake High Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuhan East Lake High Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in park operations, environmental technology, and digital technology businesses. The company's environmental protection technology business offers comprehensive flue gas treatment in coal-fired thermal power generation, dust removal for coal-fired power plants, flue gas purification for industrial facilities, municipal and industrial wastewater treatment, urban water supply, waste incineration power generation, cement, chemical and other industries, sewage treatment, water environment management, solid waste disposal business, energy conservation, and carbon reduction.
